subject: WAF/CDN renewal: cost, risk assessment & negotiation plan
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodai.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: WAF/CDN renewal: cost, risk assessment & negotiation plan

Team —

Our contracts for edge protection and CDN (Cloudflare + Fastly) come up in Q3. I pulled the current usage and preliminary numbers (attached) and we need a short paper that covers:

- 12/24 month cost projection (baseline + 20% traffic bump)
- Risk profile: single-vendor vs dual-vendor (failover, config drift, SLAs)
- Migration effort & runbook for shifting certain routes to Akamai if needed
- Negotiation anchors and walk-away thresholds (discount/credits we should ask for)

Can Marissa and Marcus take the lead on cost/technical assessment? Michael — please add any contractual constraints from finance (payment terms, PO timelines).

Deliverable: one-pager summary + 2-page backup with numbers by EOD Friday (2026-05-22). If we can, I want to schedule a negotiation prep call with Cloudflare and Fastly reps the week after.

Attachments: 2026-05-20_waf-cdn_costs_breakdown.xlsx, migration_risk_matrix.pdf

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Infrastructure Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T13:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: WAF/CDN renewal: cost, risk assessment & negotiation plan

Laura / team —

Thanks — I dug into the billing exports and attached a first-pass cost model (sheet "delta_skew"). High level observations:

- Cloudflare bandwidth overage and bot-management surcharges are our largest variable line items (~45% of incremental spend).
- Fastly edge compute spikes are episodic but responsible for ~18% of peak cost; they offer per-request discounts at committed TPU levels.
- Akamai's entry price looks higher for pure bandwidth, but their bundled security services could reduce some configuration overhead.

I added an "ask list" for negotiations (page 2): 3% baseline discount per year for 24-month term, onboarding credits, and a waiver for DDoS mitigation overruns for the first 90 days post-renewal.

Open questions for you:
- Are we comfortable with a 2-vendor strategy long-term? If yes, we can aim for staggered expiry windows to maintain leverage.
- On migration effort: Marcus, can you map the top 20 routes by token volume so we can estimate cutover time?

I'll be on a customer visit Wednesday morning but can finalize the one-pager Thursday afternoon.

Attachments: contract_redlines_Cloudflare_v2.docx

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Manager, Edge & Platform
Redwood Inference

Hi Laura / Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the level of detail — this is helpful. I'm Alex (Enterprise AE for Cloudflare) — I looped in our Sr. Solutions Engineer (cc'd) to help with the bot management line items.

A few quick items from our side:
- We can offer a tiered 12/24-month renewal with blended discounts: 7% off list for 12 months, 12% for 24 months with a 6-month price protection clause.
- We will include a $25k onboarding credit for any migration work we support and a 90-day DDoS mitigation credit for chargeback protection.
- DocuSign link for the proposed renewal term (with redlines) is here: https://docusign.com/contract/CF-RENEW-2026

We'd like to block 60 minutes next Tuesday (2026-05-26) to walk through the quota/overage triggers and mitigation options. Does 10:00am PT work for your team?

Regards,
